context.description: Start times, end times and spans come only from machine actions

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of packages/opencode/test/task/verify-spec-RM25.spec.ts (7 tests, re-run: 7 pass, 0 fail, 84 expect calls). Given: test 1 loads task-formats/blend/example-cascade.spec with the real loader (Blend.load + TaskCommand.plan via lib/machine loadPlan), asserts T1.1 budget 1, T1.2 after T1.1, T1.3 independent, and that no unit has a time or span before a fact; facts carry fixed times 1000..8000. When: folds run.started, task.started/ready/proved/verified for T1.3 (trusted) and a failing task.proved for T1.1 through the real engine API (initial/apply). Then T1.1: toEqual on startedAt=2000 (task.started), endedAt=8000 (failing proof) and spans waiting, building, proving, budget_exhausted with from===to (zero-length). And T1.2: state blocked, blockedBy T1.1 budget_exhausted, endedAt 8000, no startedAt key (asserted with 'in'); parent T1 the same. And stale: obligation.stale T1.3.c1 on the active snapshot where T1.3 is trusted moves T1.3 to proving, removes the endedAt key, sets startedAt to the stale time, keeps the trusted span closed and opens a proving span. 'Only from machine actions': a 5,000,000 clock shift moves every value by that amount, a repeat fold is equal, TaskStatus.project copies the values, and the live TaskRecorder writes the same values to status.json. Engine code (machine.ts timed/spansAfter in the enter assign action) confirms the times come from the event at. No mock of the unit under test. No gap.
